items.title: In a policy switch, the Fed says its October 2027 meeting will not see a vote on interest rates
items.summary: The Federal Reserve won't vote on a potential interest-rate change at its October 2027 meeting, a departure that is part of a broader initiative from Chairman Kevin Warsh aimed at reducing the central bank's market footprint.

items.title: Oil prices rise after Trump says no Iran deal needed: 'We've got their Strait'
items.summary: U.S. oil prices rose Thursday, as comments from President Donald Trump stoked worries that an end to the U.S.-Iran war was not in sight.

items.title: China's Ministry of State Security thrust into the spotlight by Nvidia CEO affair
items.summary: From recruitment of U.S. students to allegations surrounding Nvidia's Jensen Huang affair, reports point to one Chinese intelligence agency: the Ministry of State Security.

items.title: Prediction markets tied to clinical trials and drug approvals draw lawmakers' ire
items.summary: Prediction market event contracts on both clinical drug trials and Food and Drug Administration regulatory approvals are drawing attention from two Democratic senators, according to a letter obtained first by CNBC.

items.title: Fed's Goolsbee calls inflation report 'borderline disturbing' as central bank weighs more hikes
items.summary: Chicago Federal Reserve President Austan Goolsbee called the latest inflation data "borderline disturbing."

items.title: UK economy expands 0.7% in third quarter as AI provides 'extra engine of growth'
items.summary: The U.K. economy grew 0.7% in the third quarter, in line with estimates, driven by output in the services sector.

items.title: Analysis: Nvidia’s leadership crisis tests the chipmaker’s role as the ‘central bank of AI’
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang 's shock resignation is raising a worrying question: Could trouble at the chipmaker spread through the tightly connected financial network Nvidia has built to support the artificial intelligence boom?
